8.3.58 EthIf_TransceiverGetLinkState
[SWS_EthIf_91110] Definition of API function EthIf_TransceiverGetLinkState ⌈
Service Name
EthIf_TransceiverGetLinkState
Syntax
Std_ReturnType EthIf_TransceiverGetLinkState (
uint8 TrcvIdx,
EthTrcv_LinkStateType* LinkStatePtr
)
Service ID [hex]
0x4c
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant
Parameters (in)
TrcvIdx
Index of the transceiver within the context of the Ethernet
Transceiver Driver
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
LinkStatePtr
ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN: transceiver is disconnected
ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_ACTIVE: transceiver is connected
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: success
E_NOT_OK: transceiver could not be initialized
Description
Obtains the link state of the indexed transceiver
Available via
EthIf.h
⌋()
[SWS_EthIf_00421] ⌈The function EthIf_TransceiverGetLinkState shall for-
ward the call to function <EthTrcv>_GetLinkState of the corresponding Ethernet
Transceiver Driver (EthIfTransceiverIdx).⌋()
